architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable components in src/components/. Static assets in public/. CSS modules for scoped styling. React Router for navigation. No state management (useState/useContext only).

tickets.title: Create Hero Landing page (sugidev_hero_landing)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract inline styles to CSS module. Preserve animations, responsive breakpoints. Keep exact pixel-perfect layout.
acceptance_criteria: Component renders identical to Stitch screen

tickets.title: Create Showcase Explore section (sugidev_showcase_explore_section)
tickets.description: Build reusable ShowcaseExplore component. Extract project cards to separate component. Use CSS Grid for layout. Keep hover effects, image aspect ratios.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive grid (3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile)

tickets.title: Create Services & Projects page (sugidev_services_projects)
tickets.description: Build ServicesProjects page. Reuse ProjectCard component. Add service description section. Keep scroll-triggered animations.

tickets.title: Create Marquee About section (sugidev_marquee_about_section)
tickets.description: Build MarqueeAbout component. Implement infinite horizontal scroll. Extract marquee text to config object for easy editing.
acceptance_criteria: Text content editable via config file

tickets.title: Create Footer section (sugidev_collection_footer_section)
tickets.description: Build Footer component. Extract social links to config. Keep gradient background, newsletter signup form. Make form functional (client-side validation only).
acceptance_criteria: Social links open in new tab

tickets.title: Create Contact & Inquiry pages (contact_clean_background, project_inquiry_clean_background)
tickets.description: Build Contact and ProjectInquiry pages. Reuse form components. Add client-side validation. Keep clean background styling. Extract form fields to shared config.
acceptance_criteria: Form fields configurable via config file

tickets.title: Build reusable UI components (buttons, badges, tables)
tickets.description: Create Button, Badge, Table components. Support all variants from Stitch screens. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep exact hover/focus states.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create App shell. Add navigation bar. Set up React Router with lazy loading. Implement smooth scroll for anchor links. Keep fixed header with scroll effect.
acceptance_criteria: All pages load without full refresh
Smooth scroll works for anchor links
